purpose: Prevent MODEL_1 from collapsing toward the favourite after draw exclusion by separating bookmaker prior profiles from each match's actual lead/follow/divergence behavior, and by forcing blocking/inducement/hot/cold counter-interpretations before a home-vs-away winner decision.
core_principles: Bookmaker profiles are priors, not truth tables or fixed accuracy rankings.
The current match timeline determines whether a bookmaker is a leader, confirmer, follower, divergent source, stale/asynchronous quote, or unknown.
A low favourite price, stronger team, deeper handicap, or multi-market popular narrative cannot by itself decide the winner after draw exclusion.
Cross-market agreement is not automatically independent confirmation because correlated pricing and arbitrage can transmit the same popular narrative across 1X2, AH and OU.
When draw is excluded, the task becomes a true home-vs-away binary winner audit; the favourite receives no default priority.
Bookmaker intent remains an inference. Deliberate trapping or manipulation must never be stated as fact without direct evidence.

Macau.user_prior: Asian authoritative bookmaker; especially informative for Asian competition handicap structure.
Macau.formal_use: Inspect line choice, line-vs-water transfer, late entry into a more mature market, and whether Macau leads or merely confirms the prevailing Asian structure.
Macau.guardrail: Later opening does not mean superior information and Macau never receives automatic veto or truth status.

HKJC.user_prior: Strong local Asian-market reference with useful regional risk sensitivity.
HKJC.formal_use: Compare local Asian risk posture with Macau, European 1X2 and high-liquidity market prices.
HKJC.guardrail: Following the market is not independent predictive confirmation.

William Hill.user_prior: Traditional European benchmark; useful for result-price location and draw protection/inducement structure.
William Hill.formal_use: Primary European 1X2 reference, especially home/draw/away relative pricing and draw-price treatment.
William Hill.guardrail: Historical prestige does not create automatic correctness.

Ladbrokes UK.user_prior: European market-direction and payout-control reference; often useful for win/loss-side discrimination.
Ladbrokes UK.formal_use: Read together with William Hill for European result pricing, while separately auditing its AH timing and whether it leads or follows.
Ladbrokes UK.guardrail: Strong signal prior is not a fixed strongest-signal rule and does not override contradictory same-time evidence.

Vcbet.user_prior: Euro-Asian bridge reference with useful Asian-line convergence behavior.
Vcbet.formal_use: Secondary confirmation/divergence source for how European result views are translated into Asian handicap pricing.
Vcbet.guardrail: Lower formal authority than the core anchors; mainly useful through timing and divergence.

Pinnacle.user_prior: High-return, high-limit market that accepts professional and large action.
Pinnacle.formal_use: Capital/liquidity anchor and timing source; track whether high-liquidity repricing leads or follows other books.
Pinnacle.guardrail: Never equate Pinnacle movement with smart-money truth, insider information, or an automatic result signal.

Bet365.user_prior: Broad coverage, strong in-play infrastructure and high automation.
Bet365.formal_use: Key comparator for broad market repricing and OU/AH ladders; explicitly separate information repricing from retail/popular-flow pressure.
Bet365.guardrail: Favourite-side movement can reflect demand management and must not automatically be read as true directional information.

questions: Is the popular side being made cheaper/easier to buy, or more expensive/harder to cash?
If the book truly feared the popular side, why was the adjacent deeper/shorter counterfactual not used?
If the book truly wanted to attract the popular side, is the price/line actually convenient enough to support that claim?
Does 1X2 strengthen while AH refuses to upgrade, or does AH deepen while 1X2 refuses to confirm?
Which company moved first and which companies did not follow at the closest common time slice?
Is the weak side being made attractive to bettors or quietly protected through price compression/resistance?
Does the total/team-goal structure confirm the implied winning-margin path or contradict it?

forbidden_shortcuts: five of six companies support the favourite therefore favourite
cross-market agreement automatically means independent confirmation
Macau late opener equals most informed truth
William Hill or Ladbrokes signal automatically overrides contradictory structure
draw excluded therefore choose the stronger or more popular side

formal_placement_without_stage_reorder.stage_3_opening_first_impression: Capture company opening times and raw opening geometry without using later information.
formal_placement_without_stage_reorder.stage_4_opening_rationality_lifecycle: Run adjacent counterfactual and opening-validity tests; identify first material mover and follow sequence.
formal_placement_without_stage_reorder.stage_7_one_x_two: Assign per-match bookmaker roles and audit European result-side pricing/divergence.
formal_placement_without_stage_reorder.stage_8_asian_handicap: Audit line-vs-water transfer and Asian lead/follow behavior, keeping win and cover separate.
formal_placement_without_stage_reorder.stage_9_totals: Check whether OU and team-goal structure supports or contradicts the implied winner/margin story.
formal_placement_without_stage_reorder.stage_10_cross_market_coherence: Apply correlation guard; prioritize meaningful divergences over surface consensus.
formal_placement_without_stage_reorder.stage_11_market_attraction: Classify popular-side tax/subsidy, blocking/inducement and hot/cold construction with competing explanations.
formal_placement_without_stage_reorder.stage_12_draw_exclusion_and_winner_audit: If draw is EXCLUDED, run mandatory binary home-vs-away bookmaker-intent audit with no favourite default.
formal_placement_without_stage_reorder.stage_17_single_h1_falsification_audit: Try to falsify the selected operator-intent interpretation and overturn/rebuild H1 if material counterevidence survives.
